# NerdWallet

> NerdWallet is a personal finance platform specializing in credit card comparison, rewards optimization, and financial calculators to help consumers make informed financial decisions.

NerdWallet provides comprehensive credit card guides, comparison tools, and expert reviews covering categories like travel rewards, cash back, balance transfers, and 0% APR offers. The site combines interactive tools with educational content to help users find the best cards for their financial goals.

## Key Topics

- Credit card comparison
- Rewards cards
- Travel rewards
- Cash back
- Balance transfer
- 0% APR
- Credit building
- Sign-up bonuses
- Credit score
- Card reviews
- Personal finance
- Interest calculation
- Airline cards
- Student credit cards
- Grocery rewards

## Credit Card Discovery & Tools

- [Credit Cards: Browse, Learn and Apply](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards): Main credit card hub with browsing, comparison, and application tools
- [Side by Side Credit Card Comparison](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/compare): Interactive tool for comparing credit cards side-by-side
- [Credit Card Matching Quiz](https://www.nerdwallet.com/m/credit-cards/analyze/get-started): Credit card matching quiz tool with approval odds
- [Get a Free Credit Score](https://www.nerdwallet.com/p/free-credit-score): Free credit score monitoring service with FICO and VantageScore

## Credit Card Guides by Category

- [Best Credit Cards](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/best): Comprehensive guide to best credit cards by category and use case
- [Best Rewards Credit Cards](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/best/rewards): Guide to rewards credit cards across cash back, points, miles
- [Best Travel Credit Cards](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/best/travel): Guide to travel rewards credit cards and maximizing travel benefits
- [Best Cash Back Credit Cards](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/best/cash-back): Guide to cash back credit cards for flexible spending rewards
- [Best Balance Transfer Credit Cards](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/best/balance-transfer): Guide to balance transfer cards for debt management
- [Best 0% APR Credit Cards](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/best/zero-percent): Guide to introductory 0% APR cards for major purchases
- [Best Credit Card Bonuses for New Cardholders](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/best/bonus-offers): Guide to maximizing credit card sign-up bonuses and offers

## Specialized Credit Card Guides

- [Best Airline Credit Cards](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/best/airline): Guide to airline credit cards for frequent flyer benefits
- [Best College Student Credit Cards](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/best/college-student): Guide to credit building cards designed for college students
- [Best Credit Cards for Groceries](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/best/groceries): Guide to maximizing rewards on grocery purchases

## Expert Reviews & Analysis

- [Credit Card Reviews by NerdWallet's Experts](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/reviews): Expert reviews of popular and underrated credit cards

## Financial Calculators & Education

- [Credit Card Balance Transfer Calculator](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/learn/balance-transfer-calculator): Calculator for estimating savings from balance transfers
- [Credit Card Interest Calculator](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/learn/credit-card-interest-calculator): Calculator for computing credit card interest charges
- [Credit Card Basics](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/hubs/credit-card-basics): Beginner's guide to credit card fundamentals and APR
